articles.title: Trump picks former SEC Chairman Jay Clayton as national intelligence director
articles.description: Trump's announcement came after House Democrats' objections to his pick of Bill Pulte as acting chief ensured that a key national security tool expires Friday.

articles.title: Trump to pick US attorney Jay Clayton for director of national intelligence
articles.description: Nomination comes amid pushback over Donald Trump's selection of Bill Pulte as acting director of the agency.

articles.title: Foreign surveillance program to expire Friday after House blocks extension
articles.description: The U.S. House rejected a short-term extension of Section 702 of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act. The surveillance authority expires Friday.
